Wait they look same? Actually they are same boolean array? The difference is the array object reference? The assertion uses assertEquals(originalHeader.getFlags(), cloneHeader.getFlags()). getFlags returns maybe a boolean[]? In DNS Header, getFlags returns a boolean[]?
